summary: isascii reports whether a string is empty or contains only ASCII code points U+0000 through U+007F.
documentation: isascii reports whether a string is empty or contains only ASCII code points U+0000 through U+007F. It checks the character repertoire rather than the visual appearance or whether characters are letters.
returns: True for an ASCII-only or empty string, otherwise False.
caution: ASCII includes control characters, spaces and punctuation. Use additional validation when only printable characters or a narrower identifier grammar is acceptable.
scenarios: Check compatibility with an ASCII-only export format.
Identify text needing encoding review before a legacy upload.
Flag unexpected non-ASCII characters in machine-generated codes.
title: Check legacy encoding compatibility
problem: Return whether every character in the input string is ASCII. An empty string is compatible. Include ASCII control characters as valid for this specific check.
goal: Use str.isascii() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Call isascii; do not replace it with isalpha or isalnum.
